After 15 years at the helm, today is officially Tim Cook's final day as Apple's CEO. In April this year, Apple announced that Cook would step down as CEO on September 1, with John Ternus taking over.

Cook will not be leaving entirely, of course, as he will transition to the role of Executive Chairman of Apple's Board of Directors.

Tim Cook's final day as Apple CEO

Cook assumed the Apple CEO position in 2011, just two months after Steve Jobs's passing. Ternus, meanwhile, joined Apple in 2001 as part of the product design team and rose through the ranks rapidly, formally being promoted to Senior Vice President of Hardware Engineering in January 2021.

Bloomberg reiterated in a weekend report that Cook, upon becoming Executive Chairman, will focus on handling Apple's relationships with US President Trump and the Chinese government.

Bloomberg noted that Ternus is expected to move into Cook's current office after taking over as CEO. The Information also reported that Cook's executive assistants will remain in their roles and continue working for Ternus.

According to reports, Apple hosted a farewell dinner for Cook at Apple Park last week, during which Ternus, Laurene Powell Jobs, and other current and former Apple executives paid tribute to Cook for several hours. Cook's favourite band OneRepublic also performed at the event.

This transition comes ahead of Apple's "Surprise and Shine" special event scheduled for Wednesday, September 9. Cook will not appear at the event, which will be led by Ternus. Apple is expected to unveil a foldable iPhone Ultra, iPhone 18 Pro, and new Apple Watch models, among other products.

In recent weeks, Apple has drawn considerable criticism for a series of announcements, including price hikes for most hardware products (excluding iPhones) as well as subscription services such as Apple TV, Apple Music, and Apple One. This move conveniently paves the way for Ternus to focus on what is being hailed as the most ambitious product cycle in Apple's history.

Are you excited about Ternus taking over as Apple CEO tomorrow? What changes would you like him to make? How would you rate Cook's tenure? Let us know in the comments section.
